subject: rename procedure redis_deferring_client to valkey_deferring_client (#270)
reason: The change only renames the Tcl test helper proc redis_deferring_client to valkey_deferring_client throughout the project's own test suite (tests/*.tcl) and updates a comment in src/logreqres.c that referenced the old proc name. No server code path, command reply, replication, persistence or tool behaviour changes, so there is nothing for a scenario to reach: the two builds are behaviourally identical.
